Coram : KURIAN JOSEPH*, ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 - ss.397 to 401 - C Revisional jurisdiction - Scope of - Registration of criminal case under Prevention of Corruption Act - Closure report by police uls 173(2) Cr.P. C. - Accepted by Magistrate - High Court in exercise of revisional jurisdiction set and directed the Investigating Officer to make a - D request for sanction for prosecution - On appeal, held: The court in exercise of revisional jurisdiction not to interfere, unless the decision which is sought to be revised is perverse, untenable in law, grossly erroneous, glaringly
Decision Date : 16-01-2015 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 97/2015 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
